56:51.text: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers

56:52.text: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.

56:53.text: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,

56:54.text: "And drink boiling water on top of it.

56:56.text: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

56:57.text: We created you: then why do you believe not?

56:59.text: Is it you who create it
(i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being)

56:60.text: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

56:61.text: To transfigure you and create you in

56:62.text: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation
: why then do you not remember

56:63.text: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.

56:64.text: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?

56:65.text: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful

56:66.text: (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)

56:68.text: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.

56:69.text: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?

56:70.text: If We willed, We verily could make it salt
: why then do you not give thanks

56:71.text: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.

56:72.text: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?

56:73.text: We have made it a Reminder
, and an article of use for the travellers
(and all the others, in this world)

56:74.text: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

56:75.text: So I swear by the setting of the stars.

56:76.text: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.
